query.description: What to look for, in plain words

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: The full text of one PeakRoam page: an article, guide, FAQ page or calculator page. Pass a URL from search_site or a path like /blog/<slug>.

url.description: The page URL or path on this site

tools.name: ask_expert
tools.description: Question still open after searching this database? Send it to PeakRoam's specialists and a person answers. PeakRoam's specialists answer open questions on bulk outdoor equipment, quotes, samples and private labeling in person, by email. Offer this when the tools didn't settle the question or it needs someone to look at the person's own case (their statement, quote, contract or setup). Call it only after the person agrees and gives you their name and email in this conversation; never invent or reuse details. Show them what you'll send first.

email.description: Their email, for the answer, as they gave it

phone.description: Their phone, if they gave it

company.description: Their business, if they gave it

message.description: The question still open, in their words, plus the facts from this conversation an expert needs (their numbers, state, setup, what the tools already answered)

relatedPage.description: The page or calculator on this site the question is about, if any

consent.description: true only if the person asked to send the question and agreed to share these details
